title: Chapter 1 in GTA 6 Wipes Your Money: Save $5,000 First 💸 #Shorts
description:
When Chapter 1 ends in GTA 6, your pocket cash, Jason's floorboard stash and your BuckMe checking balance reset to zero, and you lose access to Jason's house and car. The point of no return is the mission Tourist Trap, which starts when you pick up Lucia from work. Only BuckMe Family Savings carries over: deposit up to $5,000 first, then spend the rest. Clothes you bought stay in your wardrobe and your guns wait in an Ammu-Nation weapons locker.

Sources: Game Rant, "Things to Do Before Completing Chapter 1 of GTA 6" (Nov 20, 2026); Player.One (Nov 25, 2026).
Images: Rockstar Games (An Extended Look, official screenshot). Some scenes are illustrative.
